top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §746.5207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency evacuation diagrams that are posted in the classroom do not indicate the relocation center outside of the child care center or the shelter in place location(s).

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is no policy for suspension and expulsion.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no activity plan that specified the daily activities for the current date. The June activity plan was the same for all ages and is not specific to the age groups.

top_violation_types.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon CCR's arrival the operation was using a reduced nap time ratio with only 1 caregiver present in the building and more than 13 children.
